Name: Harvey HD Portraits by Hemptress
Author: Hemptress
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Give Pelican Town’s favorite doctor a well-deserved HD glow-up. 💚
[b]Harvey HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b] replaces Harvey’s original character portraits with a detailed, semi-realistic redesign created for use with [b]Portraiture[/b].
This version keeps Harvey recognizable and faithful to his vanilla Stardew Valley design while giving him a more mature, polished, and expressive appearance. Expect a stronger jawline, fuller features, refined facial hair, improved hair detailing, and a little extra doctor-next-door charm.
Because apparently your annual checkup needed to become significantly more distracting.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] if you haven't already.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [b]Portraiture[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download [b]Harvey HD Portraits by Hemptress[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract the downloaded file.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the portrait folder inside your Portraiture portraits directory:[/color][/*]
[/list][code]Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/[/code][list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]When speaking to Harvey, use Portraiture's portrait-selection controls to choose the Hemptress portrait set if it isn't selected automatically.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]And voilà. Your local physician has been upgraded. 🩺✨[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]HD Harvey portrait replacement[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Semi-realistic Hemptress portrait style[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Designed to remain recognizable and lore-friendly[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]More defined and masculine facial structure[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Fuller lips and refined features[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Improved mustache, brows, and hair detailing[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]More expressive facial expressions[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Updated beach/island portraits[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Compatible with [b]Portraiture[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Made to pair visually with my other Hemptress HD portrait mods[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#D4D4D8]The goal was not to turn Harvey into an entirely different character. He is still the anxious, aviation-loving, health-conscious doctor we know and love.
He just looks considerably more dangerous with a stethoscope now. 🖤[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Portraiture[/b][/color]
